papers.title: InternW0-$Δ$: A World Action Model Bridging Predictive Dynamics and Actions with 20K+ Hours of Open Data
papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly model visual dynamics and action generation for generalist robot manipulation. A central challenge is to integrate priors from large-scale pretrained models---including visual dynamics, scene semantics, geometry, and motion---into a unified framework for robot action generation. We introduce InternW0-$Δ$, a unified WAM pretrained on a heterogeneous corpus that outperforms prior methods across simulation benchmarks and real-robot platforms.   InternW0-$Δ$ combines pretrained visual dynamics, scene-level semantics, 4D geometric and motion priors, and action generation within a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) framework. A pretrained video expert and an action expert interact under semantic guidance from a frozen VLM, while a pretrained 4D foundation model injects geometric and motion priors through training-only distillation. We further introduce Causal Imprint, which learns future-relevant scene changes from training-only future supervision and provides predictive representations directly to the action expert without future-video rollout at inference.   For large-scale joint training, we construct a heterogeneous corpus of robot demonstrations, UMI data, egocentric human demonstrations, and Ego2Robot data, curated and aligned under a common state-action representation. The resulting corpus contains over 20K hours of processed training data, to our knowledge the largest open-source corpus of its kind. We pretrain InternW0-$Δ$ on this corpus and demonstrate strong performance across simulation benchmarks and real-robot platforms. We will open source the training code, model weights, infrastructure, data-processing pipeline, and processed data where licenses permit. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/InternW0-Delta/

ai_summary.problem: 世界动作模型（WAM）需要同时建模视觉动态与动作生成，核心难题是如何将大规模预训练模型中的视觉动态、场景语义、几何与运动先验统一整合进机器人动作生成框架，并解决缺乏大规模高质量机器人数据的问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出 InternW0-Δ，基于 Mixture-of-Transformers 框架，让预训练视频专家与动作专家在冻结 VLM 的语义引导下交互，并通过训练期蒸馏引入预训练 4D 基础模型的几何与运动先验；同时提出 Causal Imprint，从训练期未来监督中学习与未来相关的场景变化，在推理时无需生成未来视频即可为动作专家提供预测性表征。作者还构建了涵盖机器人演示、UMI 数据、第一人称人类演示与 Ego2Robot 数据的异构语料，在统一状态-动作表征下对齐，总计超过 2 万小时，为同类最大开源语料。
ai_summary.result: 在该语料上预训练的 InternW0-Δ 在多个仿真基准和真实机器人平台上均超越已有方法，并承诺开源训练代码、模型权重、基础设施、数据处理管线及许可允许的处理数据。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过训练期蒸馏融合视频、语义与4D几何运动先验，并用 Causal Imprint 在推理时免去未来视频生成，实现预测动态与动作生成的统一。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能与世界模型提供了可扩展的多先验统一预训练范式，并释放迄今最大规模的开源机器人异构数据语料，推动通用机器人操作研究。

papers.title: Open Vocabulary Domain Unlearning
papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) exhibit remarkable zero-shot generalization, yet they often encode unwanted or hazardous stylistic domains such as idealized textbook diagrams in medical AI or cartoon vehicles in autonomous driving. Approximate Domain Unlearning (ADU) aims to selectively erase a model's recognition of a target visual domain while preserving accuracy on the remaining domains. However, existing ADU methods operate under a flawed closed-vocabulary assumption: they evaluate unlearning solely on the specific object classes seen during the unlearning fine-tuning phase. Consequently, these methods do not unlearn the domain itself; they merely overfit to seen class-domain pairs, leaving the domain easily recognizable for unseen classes and providing a false sense of removal. We argue that true domain erasure must be class-agnostic. To address this, we formalize Open-Vocabulary Domain Unlearning (OVDU), a rigorous protocol that mandates domain forgetting must transfer to held-out classes. To solve the OVDU challenge, we propose a surgical parameter-editing framework. First, a Fisher Information mask isolates domain-sensitive weights, mathematically protecting foundational zero-shot generalization. Second, our Targeted Manifold Scattering (TMS) objective uses preference-based mining to locally scatter the forget domain's stylistic geometry. Evaluated across PACS, OfficeHome, and DomainNet, our method vastly improves open-vocabulary generalization over existing baselines. Crucially, it delivers exceptional sample efficiency, outperforming peak 8-shot baseline results with only 4 shots.

ai_summary.problem: 现有近似域遗忘（ADU）方法在闭词表假设下只遗忘微调阶段见过的类别-域对，并未真正擦除视觉域本身，导致未见类别仍能识别目标域。论文要解决这一开放词表域遗忘（OVDU）问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出一种外科手术式参数编辑框架：先用Fisher信息掩码隔离域敏感权重，以保护模型基础零样本泛化能力；再用Targeted Manifold Scattering目标，通过偏好挖掘局部打散遗忘域的风格几何结构。
ai_summary.result: 在PACS、OfficeHome和DomainNet上，方法显著优于现有基线，开放词表泛化下遗忘效果更好；且样本效率极高，仅用4-shot即超过基线8-shot的最佳结果。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次形式化开放词表域遗忘协议，要求域遗忘能迁移到留出类别，并用Fisher掩码与目标流形散射实现类无关的域擦除。
ai_summary.relevance: 对VLM安全对齐、隐私/版权内容移除和域级有害风格遗忘具有重要意义，推动更可靠的开放词表模型编辑。

papers.title: DyMD: Preserving Interaction Dynamics through Distribution Matching Distillation in Few-Step Video World Models
papers.abstract: Large video diffusion models offer expressive priors for embodied prediction and learning, yet their many-step sampling remains costly for interactive downstream use. Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) enables few-step video generation, but can suppress robot--object motion while preserving visual quality. Examining DMD's teacher and fake-score signals, we find that weak re-noising keeps the teacher posterior concentrated near motion-deficient rollouts, limiting motion-restoring guidance. Meanwhile, stronger-motion rollouts tend to incur larger fake-score fitting errors, which can hinder the generator's learning of interaction dynamics. We propose DyMD, a DMD framework that adapts both teacher supervision and critic fitting to the evolving student. Temporal affinity--conditioned re-noise sampling adapts the timestep distribution to each rollout's current interaction fidelity by mixing the base schedule with a teacher prior motivated by local posterior variation, thereby balancing motion recovery and appearance refinement. To better track stronger-motion rollouts, dynamics-guided fake-score tracking uses a noise-conditioned predictor to estimate noise-relative fitting difficulty from latent temporal dynamics, then upweights predicted-hard rollouts in the critic loss. Using DyMD, we distill a 14B teacher into a four-step 1.3B student with no auxiliary modules at inference. On embodied-video benchmarks, the student improves R-Bench task adherence by $9.6$ percentage points and PAI-Bench-G Domain score by $5.1$ points over Base DMD while maintaining comparable visual quality. As a backbone for downstream action planning, our student achieves 34% mean success across two WorldArena tasks, compared with 16% for Base DMD.

ai_summary.problem: 大型视频扩散模型虽能为具身预测提供强先验，但其多步采样成本高；现有DMD少步蒸馏会抑制机器人-物体交互运动，同时保持视觉质量。
ai_summary.method: 提出DyMD，一个让教师监督和判别器拟合随学生模型演化的DMD框架：用时间亲和度条件重加噪采样，根据每个 rollout 的交互保真度自适应时间步分布，平衡运动恢复与外观精修；并用动态引导的假分数跟踪，通过噪声条件预测器估计拟合难度，在critic损失中加权更强运动 rollout。
ai_summary.result: 将14B教师蒸馏为四步1.3B学生，推理无需辅助模块；在具身视频基准上，R-Bench任务遵循提升9.6个百分点，PAI-Bench-G Domain提升5.1分，视觉质量相当；作为下游动作规划骨干，在WorldArena两个任务上平均成功率达34%，Base DMD为16%。
ai_summary.novelty: 针对少步视频世界模型中交互动态被抑制的问题，提出动态感知的DMD蒸馏，联合自适应重加噪采样和动态引导假分数跟踪来保留机器人-物体运动。
ai_summary.relevance: 有望推动高效少步视频世界模型在具身智能交互预测和动作规划中的实际部署。

papers.title: Representation-Guided Generation and Integration of Executable Programs for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Building a robotic manipulation system requires connecting perception, planning, and control through carefully designed representations and interfaces. VLM code generation offers a way to automate this construction, but independently generated components may operate on incompatible geometric and task-level information. We present Representation-guided Integration of VLM-generated Executable Task programs (RIVET), a framework for generating complete manipulation systems around a shared object-centric representation. The representation combines per-object 6D poses, which preserve the metric information required for action grounding, with a relation graph that exposes the task-level structure required for planning. Guided by this representation, a VLM generates cooperating perception, rendering, relation-inference, and planning programs, each combining task-specific computation with available packages where useful. The resulting programs are authored once for a manipulation domain and reused on unseen start and goal configurations without code regeneration. We evaluate RIVET on cube stacking, tangram rearrangement, and three-dimensional assembly in simulation and on a physical robot, where we achieve 83% overall success rate in the real world by reusing offline-generated systems. Our results demonstrate that representation-guided program generation can adapt a common manipulation framework to tasks with different geometric, relational, and sequential requirements.

ai_summary.problem: VLM 代码生成可用于构建机器人操作流程，但独立生成的感知、规划和控制组件往往基于不兼容的几何与任务级信息，难以集成为完整可用的系统。
ai_summary.method: 提出 RIVET 框架，围绕共享的以物体为中心的表示来生成完整操作程序。该表示结合每个物体的 6D 位姿（保留动作接地所需的度量信息）和关系图（暴露规划所需的任务级结构），并由 VLM 生成协同的感知、渲染、关系推理和规划程序。程序只需针对特定操作领域编写一次，即可复用于未见过的初始与目标配置。
ai_summary.result: 在仿真和真实机器人上评估了方块堆叠、七巧板重排和三维装配任务；通过复用离线生成的系统，在真实世界中取得了 83% 的总成功率。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用统一的物体中心表示引导 VLM 生成可协同执行、可跨配置复用的机器人操作程序，从而把表示设计与程序生成紧密结合。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明表示引导的程序生成能提升 VLM 在机器人操作中的系统集成与泛化能力，对具身智能和 Agent 生成可执行控制程序有参考价值。

papers.title: MA-WAM: Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Test-Time Planning
papers.abstract: Multi-agent cooperative tasks require different agents to execute a joint action simultaneously, and each agent's action affects both the observations and responses of the other agents. Hence, a world model is needed to predict the team return resulting from the joint actions of all agents. A naive extension directly applies a single-agent world model to each agent's action when predicting the team return step by step. However, such an extension fails to capture the dependencies among the simultaneous actions of multiple agents. We propose Multi-Agent World-Action Model (MA-WAM), a test-time planning framework that enables a frozen multi-agent flow policy to evaluate futures of candidate joint actions. To our knowledge, MA-WAM is the first test-time world-model planner for multi-agent flow policies. MA-WAM predicts the consequences of each joint action according to cross-agent dependencies and enables efficient candidate scoring. Across 30 offline multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) settings on MAMuJoCo, SMAC, and MPE, MA-WAM achieves mean relative gains of 22.0% over direct execution and 25.6% over uniform action selection. Under the standard evaluation protocol on an A100 GPU, MA-WAM adds 12.1 ms, accounting for 2.5% of the measured generation-and-scoring time.

ai_summary.problem: 多智能体协作任务需要多个智能体同时执行联合动作，且各智能体动作会相互影响；现有将单智能体世界模型简单扩展到多智能体逐个动作预测的方法，无法捕捉同时动作之间的依赖关系。
ai_summary.method: 提出MA-WAM（Multi-Agent World-Action Model），一种测试时规划框架，利用冻结的多智能体流策略评估候选联合动作的未来后果。它根据智能体间的交叉依赖预测每个联合动作的结果，并高效地对候选动作进行评分，是首个面向多智能体流策略的测试时世界模型规划器。
ai_summary.result: 在MAMuJoCo、SMAC和MPE的30个离线多智能体强化学习设置中，MA-WAM相比直接执行平均相对提升22.0%，相比均匀动作选择平均相对提升25.6%；在A100 GPU标准评估协议下仅增加12.1 ms，占实测生成与评分时间的2.5%。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将测试时世界模型规划与多智能体流策略结合，并通过建模智能体间交叉依赖来评估联合动作。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多智能体协作中的世界模型、测试时规划与流策略提供了新思路，有助于提升具身智能和多智能体决策系统的协同规划能力。

papers.title: Enabling a Unified Cross-Domain Representation for Two-Finger Gripper Manipulation via Interaction-Centric Modeling
papers.abstract: Achieving robust cross-embodiment generalization in imitation learning demands overcoming a critical representation flaw that inextricably entangles task semantics with hardware-specific visual geometry. We propose an interaction-centric framework that leverages the shared structure of two-finger grippers via a parameterized universal gripper abstraction, yielding a canonical gripper-frame representation. Given language and RGB-D observations, a VLM infers the subtask and grounds an interaction triplet (gripper, held, target), while SAM~2.1 tracks masks to reduce VLM queries. We design concise hybrid features that combine target/collision artificial potential fields for global guidance with segmented gripper-frame point clouds for local geometry, and use a Flow-Matching Transformer to predict smooth 7-DoF action chunks. Experiments in simulation and real-world tasks demonstrate that ours is the first imitation learning approach to simultaneously achieve competitive benchmark scores and extreme cross-embodiment/cross-viewpoint zero-shot sim-to-real transfer to completely distinct, heterogeneous robot platforms.

ai_summary.problem: 模仿学习中的跨具身泛化常因任务语义与硬件相关的视觉几何纠缠在一起而受限，难以在不同机器人平台间迁移。
ai_summary.method: 提出以交互为中心的框架，通过参数化通用两指夹爪抽象获得规范夹爪坐标系表示；利用VLM推断子任务并定位交互三元组（夹爪、持有物、目标物），结合SAM 2.1跟踪掩码减少查询；设计融合目标/碰撞人工势场与夹爪坐标系点云的混合特征，并用Flow-Matching Transformer预测平滑的7自由度动作块。
ai_summary.result: 在仿真和真实任务中，该方法首次在模仿学习领域同时取得有竞争力的基准成绩，并实现跨具身、跨视角的零样本仿真到现实迁移至完全不同的异构机器人平台。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过交互中心建模与规范夹爪坐标系表示，将任务语义从硬件特定几何中解耦，实现统一的两指夹爪跨域操作表示。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动机器人模仿学习的跨具身泛化与可扩展迁移，为通用机器人操作策略学习提供新思路。

papers.title: Structured Reasoning Agentic Framework for Interpretable Critical View of Safety Assessment
papers.abstract: Surgical scene understanding is critical for computer-assisted intervention, yet laparoscopic cholecystectomy remains challenged by the complex anatomy of the hepatocystic triangle and the risk of bile duct injury. Existing methods for Critical View of Safety (CVS) assessment typically treat it as a holistic prediction task, mapping visual features directly to criterion-level labels. This black-box paradigm lacks explicit reasoning about anatomical relationships, limiting both interpretability and compositional generalization. To address this, we propose ReasonCVS, a structured reasoning agentic framework empowered by Vision-Language Models (VLMs) that decomposes CVS assessment into explicit, fine-grained anatomical verification. Specifically, we devise an Anatomical Scene Graph Abstraction (ASGA) that organizes anatomical entities and their spatial relationships into a structured representation. To operationalize this, we introduce a Rationale-Aware Reasoning Agent, powered by a Large Language Model (LLM) fine-tuned via rationale distillation. Functioning as a strict central decision-maker, it invokes VLM-driven Sub-criterion Verifier as a specialized perceptual tool to parse the graph and independently evaluate individual sub-criteria. Through calibrated soft reasoning, this agent synthesizes the tool-gathered distributed observations, yielding a final verdict alongside a traceable clinical rationale. Extensive experiments on the Endoscapes-CVS201 benchmark demonstrate that ReasonCVS achieves superior performance (68.1\% mAP) over state-of-the-art while providing interpretable, criterion-level explanations for reliable surgical assessment.

ai_summary.problem: 腹腔镜胆囊切除术中的关键安全视野（CVS）评估通常被当作整体黑盒预测，缺乏对解剖关系的显式推理，导致可解释性和组合泛化能力不足。
ai_summary.method: 提出 ReasonCVS 结构化推理智能体框架，将 CVS 评估分解为细粒度解剖验证。该方法构建解剖场景图抽象（ASGA）组织解剖实体与空间关系，并用经理由蒸馏微调的 LLM 作为理性感知推理智能体，调用 VLM 驱动的子标准验证器评估各子标准，最终通过校准软推理输出可追溯的临床理由。
ai_summary.result: 在 Endoscapes-CVS201 基准上，ReasonCVS 达到 68.1% mAP，优于现有最先进方法，并能提供可解释的标准级评估解释。
ai_summary.novelty: 将 VLM/LLM 智能体与解剖场景图结合，把 CVS 评估从整体黑盒预测转化为结构化、可验证、可追溯的细粒度推理流程。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了结构化推理与智能体框架在医疗多模态理解中的潜力，为可解释、可组合的临床决策支持提供了新范式。

papers.title: Diagnosing the Sources of Compositional Failure in Vision-Language Models: A Controlled Analysis
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often struggle with compositional reasoning tasks, but the reasons for this underperformance remain unclear. A common hypothesis is that models struggle to integrate multiple components, leading to training interventions to improve compositional binding. However, this assumption has never been directly quantified. Existing benchmarks evaluate captions only in their composed form, making it impossible to separate the cost of joint reasoning from the cost of recognizing individual components under increasing load. We introduce COMPASS (COMPositional Analysis of SkillS), a controlled evaluation framework designed to isolate and measure the distinct factors underlying compositional failure. By comparing performance on composed captions with their decomposed counterparts , we directly quantify the cost of compositional integration across 87K image-caption pairs. Across multiple VLMs, this gap is real but partial, accounting for only part of the observed degradation. This motivates a finer-grained investigation into what additional factors govern model behavior. We analyze performance at the level of individual skills: object detection, attribute binding, and relation reasoning, using skill-targeted perturbations across 274K image-caption pairs. We find a consistent skill-specific pattern: each skill degrades primarily with the count of its own primitive type (self-load), while cross-load effects are predominantly positive, suggesting that primitives of different types provide useful grounding context. This pattern holds across standard contrastive encoders, explicitly trained compositional reasoning models, and non-contrastive architectures. These findings show that compositional degradation reflects multiple separable factors that cannot be reduced to joint reasoning alone.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在组合推理任务上表现不佳，但失败原因尚不明确；已有假设认为是多组件整合困难，却缺乏直接量化。
ai_summary.method: 提出 COMPASS 受控评测框架，通过比较完整组合标题与分解标题，在 87K 图像-标题对上直接量化组合整合成本；进一步在 274K 图像-标题对上对物体检测、属性绑定和关系推理进行技能定向扰动，分析自负载与交叉负载效应。
ai_summary.result: 组合整合成本确实存在但只能解释部分性能下降；各技能主要随自身原语数量增加而退化，交叉负载效应多为正向，说明不同类型原语可提供有用上下文；该模式在对比编码器、显式组合推理模型和非对比架构中均成立。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次通过受控分解评测和技能级扰动，将 VLM 组合失败拆解为可分离的整合成本与技能负载因素，而非笼统归因于联合推理。
ai_summary.relevance: 为理解 VLM 组合泛化失败机制、评估模型短板并设计更精准的训练干预提供了可量化的分析框架。

papers.title: OpenVAM: Open-World Visual Attention Modeling with VLMs
papers.abstract: Predicting human gaze is a core capability for applications ranging from web/UI design analysis to robotics and human-computer interaction. Yet, most visual attention modeling methods output only a dense saliency map, which is often insufficient for action: practitioners need to connect attention peaks to discrete elements in the scene (what) and understand the drivers of those peaks in context (why), while remaining robust to domain shift across natural images, commercial content, and UI/web layouts. We, therefore, introduce OpenVAM (Open-world Visual Attention Modeling with VLMs), a unified framework that jointly addresses universality and explainability across heterogeneous domains (natural scenes, commercial imagery, and UI/web layouts) and supervision modalities. OpenVAM adopts a decoupled-but-aligned design: a dedicated dense visual pathway provides stable, spatially precise localization, while an instruction-following vision--language semantic head generates grounded what/why explanations conditioned on the same image and data-type prompts. A three-stage training strategy preserves strong localization priors while progressively introducing language grounding and improving explanation alignment via parameter-efficient adaptation without perturbing the saliency branch. We further propose a scalable pipeline to generate multi-domain saliency-reason annotations for training and systematic evaluation. Experiments across diverse datasets show that OpenVAM improves robustness under domain shift while producing image-grounded explanations that make saliency predictions more interpretable.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉注意力建模多只输出密集显著性图，难以将注意力峰值关联到场景中的离散元素并解释其成因，同时跨自然图像、商业内容和UI/Web布局等异构域时鲁棒性不足。
ai_summary.method: 提出OpenVAM统一框架，采用解耦但对齐的设计：密集视觉通路提供稳定精确的空间定位，基于VLM的指令跟随语义头生成有图像依据的what/why解释；通过三阶段训练在保持定位先验的同时逐步引入语言接地，并用参数高效适配对齐解释，另提出可扩展的多域saliency-reason标注生成流程。
ai_summary.result: 在多类数据集上，OpenVAM提升了域偏移下的鲁棒性，并能生成与图像内容接地的解释，使显著性预测更可解释。
ai_summary.novelty: 将开放世界跨域视觉注意力预测与基于VLM的可解释what/why解释统一在同一框架，并通过解耦对齐架构和三阶段训练实现定位与解释的协同。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动可解释视觉注意力建模与VLM结合，有助于Web/UI设计分析、人机交互、机器人等需要理解“看哪里”和“为什么看”的应用。

papers.title: MexHat: A Dataset for Hate Speech Detection in Mexican Spanish Videos
papers.abstract: Ensuring online safety through content monitoring had raised Hate Speech Detection as a crucial task to be addressed. By essence the task demands the capture of contextual cues, which are essential for a precise understanding of the content's intent. Although automated detection approaches for the task have advanced significantly, the scarcity of non-English resources persists, limiting the ability of models to adapt to the subtle, context-dependent, and culturally related nature of multimodal content. In this paper, we introduce MexHat, a video dataset designed to capture the linguistic and cultural cues for the hate-speech detection task in a Mexican Spanish context. Our dataset comprises around 1k video clips annotated across two tasks: a three-way class evaluation (no negative content, offensive content and hate-speech content), and a fine-grained class evaluation including three hate-speech sub-categories. The dataset statistics and the baseline results highlight the inherent challenges associated with the task. Disclaimer: This paper contains sensitive content that may be disturbing to some readers.

ai_summary.problem: 非英语 hate speech 检测资源稀缺，尤其是墨西哥西班牙语视频中依赖语言和文化语境的多模态内容难以被现有模型准确识别。
ai_summary.method: 论文构建了 MexHat 视频数据集，包含约 1k 个视频片段，并设计两类标注任务：三分类（无负面内容、冒犯性内容、仇恨言论）以及三类仇恨言论子类别的细粒度分类；同时给出数据集统计和基线实验。
ai_summary.result: 数据集统计与基线结果表明该任务仍具有显著挑战性，为墨西哥西班牙语多模态仇恨言论检测提供了基准和资源。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出了面向墨西哥西班牙语视频、强调语言与文化线索且包含细粒度仇恨言论子类别标注的视频数据集。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于推动低资源、多模态和跨文化场景下的仇恨言论检测与内容安全研究。

papers.title: From Reward Signal to Visual Utility: A Controlled Audit of Medical VLM Post-Training
papers.abstract: Medical vision-language model (VLM) post-training is commonly evaluated through answer accuracy. We examine how changes in accuracy and training objectives relate to image-conditioned decisions in a controlled Qwen2.5-VL-3B study on PMC-VQA. We compare supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) restricted to the language model, expanded multimodal adaptation scopes, standard answer-only Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and a counterfactual evidence objective. On 2,000 clean-test questions, language model LoRA SFT changes correct-image accuracy by +1.10 percentage points (95% paired bootstrap CI:-0.85 to +3.05), while visual-benefit events decrease by 2.40 points and image sensitivity decreases by 5.60 points. Paired records reveal 155 acquired and 203 lost visual-benefit events. Broader adaptation yields lower correct-image accuracy than language-model LoRA SFT. Standard GRPO produces mixed-reward groups and parameter updates, with an uncertain clean test accuracy change. A generation audit reveals that canonical option scores can follow a different token path from generated answers. With scores taken along the greedy generation path, the evidence target improves on the training set; its gains over standard GRPO remain inconsistent on validation data at matched training doses. Sample-level analyses trace how evidence scores, decision margins, and generated answers change during post-training. This empirical and measurement audit identifies gaps between optimization activity, target acquisition, and useful held-out visual behavior.

ai_summary.problem: 医学视觉语言模型（VLM）的后训练通常仅用答案准确率评估，本文要审计准确率与训练目标的变化是否真正对应图像条件下的决策改善。
ai_summary.method: 在PMC-VQA上以Qwen2.5-VL-3B进行受控实验，比较仅语言模型LoRA的SFT、扩展多模态适配、标准答案-only GRPO以及反事实证据目标，并引入配对bootstrap、生成路径审计和样本级分析。
ai_summary.result: 仅语言模型LoRA SFT使正确图像准确率变化+1.10个百分点（95% CI -0.85至+3.05），但视觉收益事件减少2.40点、图像敏感性降低5.60点；标准GRPO的干净测试准确率变化不确定，证据目标仅在训练集改善且验证集上相对GRPO优势不一致。
ai_summary.novelty: 将医学VLM后训练评估从答案准确率扩展到图像条件决策与视觉效用，并系统审计优化活动、目标获取和留出视觉行为之间的差距。
ai_summary.relevance: 提示医学VLM和奖励优化研究不能只看准确率，需要更关注模型是否真正利用视觉证据并产生可泛化的图像条件行为。

papers.title: ViSTA: A Simple Bridge Extends Visual Alignment to Clinical Time-Series Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
papers.abstract: Clinical prediction models estimate risk from patient measurements, while large language models support medical text understanding and question answering. Yet their language capabilities do not ensure accurate prediction from structured, high-dimensional clinical time series. Improving this ability would connect risk estimation with flexible questions about a patient's evolving condition. We introduce ViSTA, a compact adapter that incorporates irregular numerical measurements into a pretrained vision-language model's chart representations. It learns corrections to visual tokens while leaving all pretrained parameters unchanged. On MIMIC-IV, ViSTA has the highest mean scores among the compared adaptations on all four metrics for acute kidney injury and mortality prediction across models with 2-9 billion parameters. With 0.516 million trainable parameters, the 2-billion-parameter model reaches an area under the ROC curve of 0.7376 for acute kidney injury, compared with GPT-5.6 Sol's 0.7380 with text input and high reasoning effort. Training for temporal question answering yields 69.27% accuracy at 4 billion parameters with over 90% fewer trainable parameters than low-rank adaptation using charts or numerical text, at a 2.82-4.88 percentage-point accuracy gap. ViSTA extends pretrained language models to numerical prediction and temporal questions.

ai_summary.problem: 临床预测模型能从患者测量数据估计风险，而大语言模型擅长医学文本理解与问答，但后者无法直接对结构化、高维、不规则的临床时间序列做出准确预测；论文试图把风险估计与关于患者病情演变的灵活问答能力连接起来。
ai_summary.method: 提出 ViSTA：一个轻量适配器，把不规则的数值型临床测量注入到预训练视觉-语言模型的图表（chart）表示中，通过学习对视觉 token 的修正来对齐数值信息，同时保持所有预训练参数冻结不变。
ai_summary.result: 在 MIMIC-IV 上，对急性肾损伤（AKI）和死亡预测的四项指标均取得对比适配方法中的最高平均分（2B–9B 模型）；仅 5.16 万可训练参数的 2B 模型在 AKI 上 AUC 达 0.7376，接近 GPT-5.6 Sol 文本输入高推理强度的 0.7380；时序问答在 4B 模型上达 69.27% 准确率，可训练参数比 LoRA 少 90% 以上，精度差距仅 2.82–4.88 个百分点。
ai_summary.novelty: 用极小的适配器把视觉-语言模型的图表表示空间“借用”为临床时间序列的数值对齐通道，无需改动预训练权重即可让语言模型同时具备数值预测与时间问答能力。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型接入结构化时序/数值数据提供了一条参数高效、可复用的路线，对医疗AI及更广泛的“大模型+时序/科学数据”研究具有参考价值。

papers.title: Sorry Robot, Happy Human: Vision-Language Models Read Only One of Two Legible Typographic Layers
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs), despite their success in optical character recognition (OCR) tasks, are vulnerable to typographic attacks and have a fragile structure for images with multiple text layers. In this study, the DecoyBench dataset was created using the Decoy Font method. The dataset consists of 300 images, each containing text with sharp contour lines superimposed on another text with soft shading. Six recent closed-source models from three different model families were evaluated using this dataset under two different prompting conditions (naive and guided) and at two different resolutions ($512\times512$ and $64\times64$). A validation study showed that human participants could read both text layers with high accuracy. In contrast, the models, with most variants and both prompting methods, read the contour text with near-human accuracy at high resolution, but almost never fully extracted the shading text. At low resolution, the contour text could not be read by either the models or humans, while the shading text could be extracted with high accuracy. The findings indicate that the evaluated VLMs exhibit a consistent behavioral limitation when processing typographic structures containing multiple spatial frequency layers.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在OCR任务中虽有优势，却容易受到排版攻击，且在处理包含多个文本层的图像时结构脆弱，本文旨在探究VLM能否像人类一样同时读取两层可读的文字。
ai_summary.method: 研究者用Decoy Font方法构建了DecoyBench数据集，包含300张图片，每张图由一层轮廓锐利的文字叠加在另一层柔和阴影文字之上。随后在两种提示条件（naive和guided）和两种分辨率（512×512和64×64）下评估了来自三个模型家族的六个近期闭源模型，并进行了人类被试的对照验证。
ai_summary.result: 人类被试能高准确率地读出两层文字；而在高分辨率下，多数模型及两种提示方式都能以接近人类的准确率读取轮廓文字，却几乎从不完整提取阴影文字；在低分辨率下，模型和人类都无法读取轮廓文字，但阴影文字反而能被高准确率提取。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次通过双层空间频率排版文字（DecoyBench）揭示VLM在处理多层可读文字时存在与人类不同的、系统性的行为局限。
ai_summary.relevance: 该发现揭示了VLM在多模态视觉感知与OCR鲁棒性方面的结构性缺陷，对提升模型对人类视觉层次化文本处理的模拟能力及防御排版攻击具有参考意义。

papers.title: Differential Attention Unlocks Complementary EEG and Speech Fusion for Emotion Recognition
papers.abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition (MER) increasingly pairs EEG with speech, treating internal neural signals and external vocal expression as informative views of affect. In practice, naive fusion underperforms the stronger single modality, because EEG artifacts inject noise that corrupts the shared representation. We introduce EmoSpeechBrain, a multimodal framework built on the insight that noise suppression is a precondition for effective fusion. Its EEG encoder uses differential attention, taking the difference between two attention maps to cancel shared noise and isolate discriminative neural activity. An attention-based gating adapter aligns both modalities in a shared space and weights each one's contribution to the prediction. On two datasets - PME4 and EAV, EmoSpeechBrain improves MER accuracy by up to 12.9% over other state-of-the-art (SOTA) EEG encoders, and surpasses unimodal speech and EEG baselines by up to 13.1% and 23.1%. These results show that once EEG noise is suppressed, fusion delivers gains that naive combination cannot.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态情感识别中，EEG与语音的朴素融合往往不如单一强模态，原因是EEG伪迹带来的噪声会污染共享表征。
ai_summary.method: 提出EmoSpeechBrain框架：EEG编码器采用差分注意力（differential attention），用两个注意力图相减以抵消共有的噪声、凸显有判别力的神经活动；再用基于注意力的门控适配器将两个模态对齐到共享空间并加权各自对预测的贡献。
ai_summary.result: 在PME4和EAV两个数据集上，MER准确率较其他SOTA EEG编码器最高提升12.9%，并分别超过单模态语音与EEG基线最高13.1%和23.1%，说明抑制EEG噪声后融合能带来朴素组合无法获得的增益。
ai_summary.novelty: 把"先降噪再融合"作为多模态融合的前提，用差分注意力机制显式消除EEG共享噪声，并配以门控适配器实现互补融合。
ai_summary.relevance: 为脑电-语音等多模态情感计算提供了"降噪优先"的融合范式，对多模态表征学习与生理信号处理有参考价值。

papers.title: UniAR: A Unified Framework for Autism Recognition Enhanced by Multi-View Prompt Learning
papers.abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a complex neurodevelopmental disorder for which early and accurate diagnosis is critical to improving long-term developmental outcomes. However, existing ASD recognition methods are often constrained by the scarcity of diagnostic text data, forcing them to rely mainly on visual analysis and limiting their ability to model clinically meaningful semantic reasoning. To address this challenge, we propose UniAR, a unified framework enhanced by multi-granularity prompt learning for robust ASD recognition under heterogeneous data variations. Specifically, UniAR leverages a large multimodal model to generate hierarchical diagnostic descriptions at the word, phrase, and sentence levels, compensating for the lack of paired clinical reports. To align the generated semantics with visual evidence, we further design a Mixture-of-Experts-based Multi-Scale Alignment Module, which dynamically matches vector-quantized visual prototypes with semantic representations at corresponding granularities. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks covering brain MRI and facial expression scenarios show that UniAR consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods, achieving average accuracies of 75.9\% on MRI benchmarks and 91.6\% on facial benchmarks, while improving average Accuracy on MRI benchmarks by 1.5 percentage points and average Accuracy on facial benchmarks by 1.2 percentage points over baselines. These results demonstrate that UniAR offers a robust and interpretable framework for ASD screening under semantic scarcity.

ai_summary.problem: 自闭症谱系障碍早期准确诊断困难，现有方法受诊断文本数据稀缺限制，主要依赖视觉分析，缺乏临床语义推理能力。
ai_summary.method: 提出UniAR统一框架，利用大型多模态模型生成词、短语、句子级诊断描述以补偿配对临床报告的缺失；设计基于混合专家（MoE）的多尺度对齐模块，将向量量化视觉原型与对应粒度的语义表示动态匹配。
ai_summary.result: 在涵盖脑MRI和面部表情的四个基准上持续优于现有SOTA，MRI基准平均准确率75.9%，面部基准91.6%，相比基线分别提升1.5和1.2个百分点。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过多粒度提示学习生成层次化诊断语义，并用MoE多尺度对齐视觉原型与语义表示，在语义稀缺下实现鲁棒且可解释的自闭症识别。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态医疗诊断中语义稀缺问题提供了可借鉴的统一框架，结合大模型生成语义与多尺度对齐提升可解释性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: Enhancing Photogrammetric Digital Surface Models with Pretrained Diffusion Models and Multimodal Conditioning
papers.abstract: Large-scale Digital Surface Models (DSMs) can be produced cost-effectively from satellite images via stereo-photogrammetry. However, the resulting 3D maps are often contaminated by noise, outliers, and voids. On the other hand, aerial LiDAR provides high-accuracy elevation measurements at a substantially higher cost. In this work, we study diffusion models conditioned both on photogrammetric DSMs and Pléiades imagery to refine vertically co-registered DSMs. We introduce a modified Stable Diffusion 3 architecture with a pruned text stream and a patch-wise normalization strategy, enabling stable training on LiDAR data and transfer from natural images to elevation maps. Experiments in French cities demonstrate that multimodal conditioning improves elevation accuracy, reducing Dense Urban RMSE from 6.00 to 3.45 m in the in-context cities and from 4.16 to 2.77 m in the held-out city of Bordeaux.

ai_summary.problem: 卫星立体摄影测量可低成本生成大规模数字表面模型（DSM），但结果常含噪声、异常值和空洞；高精度LiDAR成本高昂，如何以低成本提升DSM高程精度是核心问题。
ai_summary.method: 提出一种改进的Stable Diffusion 3架构，同时以摄影测量DSM和Pléiades影像为条件进行扩散式精化；通过剪枝文本流和分块归一化策略，实现从自然图像到高程图的迁移，并支持在LiDAR数据上稳定训练。
ai_summary.result: 在法国城市实验中，多模态条件显著提升高程精度：Dense Urban RMSE从6.00 m降至3.45 m，留出城市Bordeaux从4.16 m降至2.77 m。
ai_summary.novelty: 将预训练扩散模型与摄影测量DSM、卫星影像多模态条件结合，并改造Stable Diffusion 3以用于DSM高程精化。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了扩散模型在遥感高程重建中的跨域迁移潜力，可降低高精度DSM对昂贵LiDAR的依赖。

papers.title: EAServe: Encode-Aware Disaggregated Serving for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Disaggregating the two stages, Prefill and Decode, onto separate GPU pools is now a standard optimization for (text-only) LLM serving. However, multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), which add a third phase, Encode, pose new challenges for resource allocation. Encode turns images, video, or audio into embeddings that the language model can consume, yielding a three-stage Encode-Prefill-Decode (EPD) pipeline. Existing frameworks offer only partial answers: text-only PD systems lack Encode, while EPD frameworks expose it as a separate service without regulating downstream request flow. The pipeline also carries a structural resource imbalance: every request enters through Encode before downstream work can begin, yet per-request execution leaves the encode GPU severely underutilized even at high loads, starving the downstream Prefill and Decode workers. Addressing this, we reposition Encode as the control point of the EPD pipeline, exposing three tightly coupled dimensions: when work enters downstream, where prefill executes, and how the GPU is shared. We instantiate this in EAServe across two co-designed layers. Its runtime manages load-adaptive micro-batching, rate-controlled partial offload to a co-resident prefill worker, and dynamic SM partitioning for predictable co-location. The configuration layer, Hybrid Auto Selection (HAS), navigates the joint space of GPU allocation, encode batch size, and offload ratio by pruning unbalanced allocations with per-stage capacity profiling and refining the remainder through TPE-based Bayesian optimization. Evaluated on three MLLM architectures spanning image, video, and audio, EAServe delivers up to 4.3x and 1.7x higher goodput than NVIDIA Dynamo and vLLM, respectively, under identical SLO constraints, sustains more balanced and higher GPU utilization across the EPD pipeline, and reaches near-optimal configurations faster than baseline search methods.

papers.title: SatNav: A Scalable Benchmark for Long-Horizon UAV Vision-Language Navigation from Satellite Imagery
papers.abstract: Urban uncrewed aerial vehicle (UAV) vision-language navigation (VLN) requires agents to follow instructions across extended urban spaces, inherently demanding long-term memory and geospatial grounding. However, scaling existing benchmarks remains difficult because of their reliance on costly reconstructed 3D assets, limiting geographic diversity and episode scale. To address this, we introduce SatNav, a scalable, long-horizon UAV VLN benchmark built from high-resolution satellite imagery. SatNav targets city-level navigation missions and uses satellite crops as approximations of UAV nadir views for visual observations. Through an automated cue-to-episode pipeline, SatNav constructs 118K episodes from 59 scenes across 18 cities, with an average trajectory length of 379 m. To stress-test long-horizon memory and geospatial reasoning, SatNav defines three task families: Boundary, Landmark, and Route, targeting loop progress tracking, landmark-based spatial grounding, and route following with counting cues. Benchmarking classical VLN agents and recent agents based on large vision-language models (LVLMs) on SatNav shows that city-scale navigation remains challenging. We further introduce SwiftVLN, a modular framework with switchable memory components, and conduct systematic memory-design ablations. Finally, satellite-to-UAV transfer experiments show that satellite-trained navigation models can operate on real-flight UAV observations, showing the practical relevance of SatNav. Our project page: https://eku127.github.io/SatNav/

papers.title: Towards VLA-Dreamer: Refining VLA Behavior Using World Models
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs), while showing strong potential for robot control, require massive amounts of high-quality imitation learning data. Moreover, the absence of an explicit world model casts further doubt on their control capabilities. In this concept paper, we propose a novel architecture that addresses sample efficiency in VLAs by training a predictive world model on the embedding space of the VLA's vision encoder. We hypothesize that these embeddings are action-relevant and usable for future prediction. To this end, we propose using the suggested architecture to investigate how well these embeddings predict the future based on actions, as the inability to do so would mark a key limitation of VLA architectures: the lack of a non-lossy implicit world model to simulate real-world dynamics. The proposed architecture differs from the standard world model dynamics as the loss comes from the embedding space rather than the pixel space, similar to joint embedding predictive architectures. Furthermore, the trained world model can be utilized for short-term planning tasks by sampling VLA actions given goal images. We intend to examine the richness of vision embeddings in VLAs and reduce their high data requirements through a world model that can also generate plans during inference.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）需要大量高质量模仿学习数据，且缺乏显式世界模型，导致其控制能力和样本效率受限。
ai_summary.method: 提出在VLA视觉编码器的嵌入空间上训练预测性世界模型，损失作用于嵌入空间而非像素空间，类似联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）；训练后的世界模型可用于短时规划，给定目标图像采样VLA动作。
ai_summary.result: 这是一篇概念论文，尚未给出实验验证；作者计划探究VLA视觉嵌入对未来预测的丰富性，并通过世界模型降低VLA的高数据需求。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次提出将VLA视觉编码器的嵌入空间作为JEPA式潜在世界模型，用于动作条件预测和短时规划，而非在像素空间建模动力学。
ai_summary.relevance: 为VLA与世界模型结合提供了新思路，有望提升机器人控制的样本效率、规划能力和可解释性。

papers.title: CoralPlan: Observation Skill Selection and Execution for Underwater Robotic Inspection
papers.abstract: Underwater robotic inspection depends on acquiring views that reveal task-relevant structure. For a structurally complex coral colony, recognising the target is only the starting point: the robot must select and execute a viewing motion suited to the inspection task. We present CoralPlan, a vision-language system that selects an observation skill from a current camera image and task text supplied by an episode manifest. A shared motion interface executes orbit, patch, or survey as target-relative trajectories; the remaining plan fields provide operator guidance. Observation completion requires target keeping and primitive-specific coverage, while joint success also requires selection to match the recorded reference. We evaluate this interface in 144 simulated episodes and 36 matched simulation-hardware pairs. In a clear-water pool with external target-reference poses, hardware observation completion reaches 77.8% and joint success reaches 63.9%. The experiments identify both reference-mismatched completions and incomplete observations after a matching skill selection. These results connect observation-skill choice to measurable underwater execution outcomes and identify where task-directed acquisition succeeds or fails.

ai_summary.problem: 水下机器人巡检不仅需要识别目标，还需要根据任务选择并执行合适的观察运动，以获取能揭示任务相关结构的视角。
ai_summary.method: 提出CoralPlan视觉-语言系统，从当前相机图像和任务文本中选择观察技能（orbit、patch或survey），并通过共享运动接口以目标相对轨迹执行；完成观察需保持目标并满足特定覆盖要求，联合成功还要求技能选择与参考一致。
ai_summary.result: 在144个仿真回合和36对仿真-硬件匹配实验中，清水池硬件观察完成率为77.8%，联合成功率为63.9%；实验还揭示了参考不匹配的完成和技能选择匹配但观察不完整等失败模式。
ai_summary.novelty: 将视觉-语言观察技能选择与可测量的水下执行结果相连接，并定义了观察完成与联合成功的评估接口。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能和水下机器人中任务驱动的感知-动作选择提供了可评估的系统框架与实验证据。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（作者机构信息为空）

key_lab_papers.title: ViSTA: A Simple Bridge Extends Visual Alignment to Clinical Time-Series Understanding in Multimodal LLMs
key_lab_papers.abstract: Clinical prediction models estimate risk from patient measurements, while large language models support medical text understanding and question answering. Yet their language capabilities do not ensure accurate prediction from structured, high-dimensional clinical time series. Improving this ability would connect risk estimation with flexible questions about a patient's evolving condition. We introduce ViSTA, a compact adapter that incorporates irregular numerical measurements into a pretrained vision-language model's chart representations. It learns corrections to visual tokens while leaving all pretrained parameters unchanged. On MIMIC-IV, ViSTA has the highest mean scores among the compared adaptations on all four metrics for acute kidney injury and mortality prediction across models with 2-9 billion parameters. With 0.516 million trainable parameters, the 2-billion-parameter model reaches an area under the ROC curve of 0.7376 for acute kidney injury, compared with GPT-5.6 Sol's 0.7380 with text input and high reasoning effort. Training for temporal question answering yields 69.27% accuracy at 4 billion parameters with over 90% fewer trainable parameters than low-rank adaptation using charts or numerical text, at a 2.82-4.88 percentage-point accuracy gap. ViSTA extends pretrained language models to numerical prediction and temporal questions.

ai_summary.problem: 临床预测模型能从患者测量数据估计风险，而大语言模型擅长医学文本理解与问答，但后者无法直接对结构化、高维、不规则的临床时间序列做出准确预测；论文试图把风险估计与关于患者病情演变的灵活问答能力连接起来。
ai_summary.method: 提出 ViSTA：一个轻量适配器，把不规则的数值型临床测量注入到预训练视觉-语言模型的图表（chart）表示中，通过学习对视觉 token 的修正来对齐数值信息，同时保持所有预训练参数冻结不变。
ai_summary.result: 在 MIMIC-IV 上，对急性肾损伤（AKI）和死亡预测的四项指标均取得对比适配方法中的最高平均分（2B–9B 模型）；仅 5.16 万可训练参数的 2B 模型在 AKI 上 AUC 达 0.7376，接近 GPT-5.6 Sol 文本输入高推理强度的 0.7380；时序问答在 4B 模型上达 69.27% 准确率，可训练参数比 LoRA 少 90% 以上，精度差距仅 2.82–4.88 个百分点。
ai_summary.novelty: 用极小的适配器把视觉-语言模型的图表表示空间“借用”为临床时间序列的数值对齐通道，无需改动预训练权重即可让语言模型同时具备数值预测与时间问答能力。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型接入结构化时序/数值数据提供了一条参数高效、可复用的路线，对医疗AI及更广泛的“大模型+时序/科学数据”研究具有参考价值。
